overall_goal: Add and mix tomato puree into the frying pan.

goals.description: Retrieve and open the tomato puree tube.
goals.rationale: The person closes the drawer, places the tomato puree tube on the counter, and later picks it up to open and pierce its foil seal.

goals.description: Measure and mix the tomato puree into the pan.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a spoon from the cupboard, uses it to measure a spoonful of tomato puree, adds it to the frying pan, and stirs the ingredients together.
